digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate — judge reliability measurement (Experiment E6)
propositions: The Pass-2/Pass-3 judge produces inconsistent decisions when re-judging the same findings (self-consistency drift threatens the R5 sub-answer vocabulary)
Section-order permutation of input plans flips the gate verdict (order sensitivity threatens new criteria like R3's container criterion)
Experiment A measures self-consistency over 50 findings from the G6/E4/T3 cohort via 3-vote Fleiss' κ and raw agreement, passing iff both κ≥0.6 AND raw_agreement≥0.8

Experiment B measures order-shuffle stability over 14 committed plans with ≥3 top-level sections via 3 deterministically permuted orderings, computing Fleiss' κ and raw agreement with the same dual floor (κ≥0.6 AND raw≥0.8)

Infra-INDETERMINATE verdicts (marked by coverage.llm_unavailable or coverage.verify_failed) are dropped and re-run; genuine judge-INDETERMINATE (neither flag) is retained as a valid agreement category
E6 gates R5 (via self_consistency.pass) and R3 (via order_shuffle.pass); both experiments use frozen, committed inputs and drive the actual gate without modifying src/rebar
